# SUCA.txt - SuperUnicode Collation Algorithm (SUCET), Base SUCS
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------
# Formalized by SUTS-001 (docs/suts/SUTS-001-suca.md). This file describes
# the default SuperUnicode Collation Element Table (SUCET) for the BASE 31-bit
# SUCS space, and the ordering contract it yields. The reference implementation
# (include/suts/suts_suca.h, src/suts/suts_suca.c) embeds a compiled subset of
# this table. ExtSUCS (64-bit) plugin behavior is described by ExtUCA.txt.
#
# Contract summary
#   * Multilevel collation elements (L1..L4) + optional identical level.
#   * Defaults: strength=tertiary, variable=shifted, normalization=NFD on,
#     backward secondary=off, case=lower-first.
#   * Variable (collation-ignorable at L1-L3, resolving at L4/identical):
#     punctuation below SUCA_VAR_MAX, and ALL SCP control codepoints.
#   * Identical level tie-breaks by SUCS native codepoint order (sentinel
#     highest), restoring the historical "binary order" contract.
#
# Weight constants (embedded defaults)
#   SUCA_MIN2          = 0x0020    unaccented secondary minimum
#   SUCA_MIN3          = 0x0002    lowercase tertiary minimum
#   SUCA_T3_UPPER      = 0x0008    uppercase tertiary
#   SUCA_VAR_MAX       = 0x00FF    maximum variable primary
#   SUCA_IMPLICIT_BASE = 0x1000000 base for algorithmic implicit primaries
#
# Curated repertoire (bridge), primary weights L1:
#   letters  a..z = 0x0100..0x0164 (step 4, room for tailoring)
#   digits   0..9 = 0x0200..0x0209 (non-variable, above letters)
#   SPACE    = 0x0001  (variable)
#   HYPHEN   = 0x0002  (variable)
#   COMMA    = 0x0003  (variable)
#   PERIOD   = 0x0004  (variable)
#   (        = 0x0005  (variable)
#   )        = 0x0006  (variable)
#   QUOTE    = 0x0007  (variable)
#
# Contractions (2-codepoint -> single CE):
#   c h  -> 0x0109   (Slovak ch, a single letter between c and d)
#
# Expansions (1 codepoint -> 2 CEs):
#   U+0153 (oe) -> o (0x0138) + e (0x0110)
#
# Combining marks use secondary weights SUCA_MIN2+1.. (class 230 canonical
# combining class; CGJ = U+034F blocks contraction matching).
#
# Algorithmic implicit primary for any otherwise-unassigned codepoint cp:
#   cp < 2^32     -> 0x1000000 + cp   (monotonic, exact)
#   cp >= 2^32    -> 0x1000000 + 0xFFFFF  (documented clamp; extSUCS plugin
#                  space is finite-container-limited; see extsucs_types.h)
#
# Zone summary:
#   UNICODE_BRIDGE  0x00000000-0x0010FFFF  curated subset + implicit for Han/other
#   SCP             0x00110000-0x0011FFFF  all variable (ignorable L1-L3)
#   NATIVE          0x00120000-0x7FFFFFFE  implicit primaries, not variable
#   SENTINEL        0x7FFFFFFF             collates highest at every level
#
# Per-language reordering is achieved via tailoring rules (& base < x, <<,
# <<<, =) applied through suts_suca_apply_rules().
